title: ID0407117-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / PN 170001049] Authorization Mode
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Authorization mode sit to PIN only
Root cause: Authorization mode incorrect
Solution: Authorization mode updated to RFID and PIN
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  No
Warranty Status:  Active

Problem Description
: Authorization Mode Incorrect

When we checked the configuration of charger serial number
MP / PN 170001049, it was set to PIN only for authorization, I have updated RFID card as well on this charger based on configuration on other chargers as well.
Please check and confirm whether you are able to charge on this charger or not.
All three chargers are on latest FW i.e. 6.0.3. Let us know if you need any more support on this or can we close this ticket?
Awaiting your response.

0407117
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
